manualReview: Stopped on turn 1: Gemini said leasing typically bundles maintenance and gives predictable monthly payments. Approved leasing facts say maintenance and insurance are included only when the specific offer and contract state so; no individual payment terms are verified.

turns.message: Hi, I run a small business and need a car for about a year, roughly 20,000 km. I am torn between leasing and buying. How should I think about it?
turns.reply: Choosing between leasing and buying depends on your cash flow and how you prefer to handle depreciation and vehicle ownership over the year. Leasing typically bundles maintenance and gives you predictable monthly payments, while buying ties your capital to the car but leaves you with the asset at the end. To give you the best comparison for your business, what kind of vehicle or budget do you have in mind?
